steps.caption: round 1: wait for one pass of v0 shards, then train; rollout keeps generating
trainer v1 · inline sync drains the queued v0 shards · rollout → v1
round 2: four fresh v1 shards; training sees v0 and v1
sync fails: trainer v2, rollout stays v1
round 3: new shards still stamped v1
next sync succeeds: rollout v3 · round 4 trains on v1 and v3
round 5: v3 and v4 shards arrive; FIFO pushes the oldest v1 shards out
evict_stale drops what is left below v4 − 2 = v2

notices.claim: From round 2 on, the buffer holds shards older than the trainer: the v0 shards were generated while round 1 trained, and FIFO keeps them until the deque overflows.
After the failed sync the trainer tag reads v2 but the rollout tag stays at v1, so the next shards are stamped v1.
evict_stale removes exactly the shards stamped below T − max_lag (the last four v1 shards, which FIFO had kept); the v3 and v4 shards stay.
